```sql
  JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
  JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
  JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
```

```sql
SELECT
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
FROM
    orders o
JOIN
    lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE
    o.o_orderdate >= '1993-10-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate < '1994-01-01'
    AND l.l_returnflag = 'R'
GROUP BY
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_name,
    c.c_acctbal,
    n.n_name,
    c.c_address,
    c.c_phone,
    c.c_comment
ORDER BY
    revenue DESC
LIMIT 20
```

SELECT s.s_name, s.s_address
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN partsupp ps ON s.s_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN part p ON ps.ps_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN lineitem l ON ps.ps_suppkey = l.l_suppkey AND ps.ps_partkey = l.l_partkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'CANADA'
  AND p.p_name LIKE 'forest%'
  AND ps.ps_availqty > (
      SELECT SUM(l2.l_quantity)
      FROM lineitem l2
      WHERE l2.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
        AND l2.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey
        AND l2.l_shipdate >= '1994-01-01'
        AND l2.l_shipdate < '1995-01-01'
  )
ORDER BY s.s_name

SELECT
    n.n_name AS nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) - ps.ps_supplycost * l.l_quantity) AS sum_profit
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN
    partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN
    nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
WHERE
    p.p_name LIKE '%green%'
GROUP BY
    n.n_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY
    n.n_name ASC,
    o_year DESC

```sql
SELECT
```
    n1.n_name AS supp_nation,
    n2.n_name AS cust_nation,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate) AS l_year,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
FROM
    lineitem l
        ```sql
JOIN
        ```
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    nation n1 ON c.c_nationkey = n1.n_nationkey
JOIN
    supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN
    nation n2 ON s.s_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
WHERE
    n1.n_name = 'FRANCE' AND n2.n_name = 'GERMANY'
    OR
    n1.n_name = 'GERMANY' AND n2.n_name = 'FRANCE'
AND
    l.l_shipdate BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY
    n1.n_name,
    n2.n_name,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.l_shipdate)
ORDER BY
    n1.n_name,
    n2.n_name,
    l_year

    ```sql
SELECT
    ```

  SUM(CASE WHEN n3.n_name = 'BRAZIL' 
      THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) 
      ELSE 0 END) /

FROM orders o
JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN nation n2 ON c.c_nationkey = n2.n_nationkey
JOIN region r ON n2.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
JOIN part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
JOIN nation n3 ON s.s_nationkey = n3.n_nationkey
WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA'

  AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
  AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate)
ORDER BY o_year

    p.p_type,
    p.p_size,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ps.ps_suppkey) AS supplier_cnt

```sql
  SELECT 
```
    s.s_suppkey,
    s.s_name,
    s.s_address,
    s.s_phone,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
  FROM lineitem l
  JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
  WHERE l.l_shipdate >= '1996-01-01' 
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1996-04-01'
  GROUP BY s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone

SELECT

  s_name,
  s_address,

  total_revenue
FROM supplier_revenue
WHERE total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM supplier_revenue)

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN p.p_type LIKE 'PROMO%' THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount))) AS promo_revenue
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE
    l.l_shipdate >= '1995-09-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate < '1995-10-01'

    c.c_custkey,
    o.o_orderkey,

    SUM(l.l_quantity) AS sum_quantity

JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
GROUP BY c.c_name, c.c_custkey, o.o_orderkey, o.o_orderdate, o.o_totalprice
HAVING SUM(l.l_quantity) > 300
ORDER BY o.o_totalprice DESC, o.o_orderdate ASC
LIMIT 100

```sql
SELECT 
```
    s.s_name,
    COUNT(*) AS numwait
FROM supplier s
JOIN nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN lineitem l ON s.s_suppkey = l.l_suppkey
JOIN orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
WHERE n.n_name = 'SAUDI ARABIA'
    AND o.o_orderstatus = 'F'
    AND l.l_receiptdate > l.l_commitdate
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM lineitem l2 
        WHERE l2.l_orderkey = l.l_orderkey 
        AND l2.l_suppkey != l.l_suppkey
    )
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 
        FROM lineitem l3 
        WHERE l3.l_orderkey = l.l_orderkey 
        AND l3.l_suppkey != l.l_suppkey 
        AND l3.l_receiptdate > l3.l_commitdate
    )
GROUP BY s.s_name
ORDER BY numwait DESC, s.s_name
LIMIT 100

The user wants to find suppliers in Canada who have, for at least one part whose name starts with 'forest', an available quantity greater than half of the total quantity of that part shipped by that supplier in 1994.

1. Suppliers must be in Canada (need to join supplier -> nation -> region)
2. For at least one part whose name starts with 'forest'
3. The available quantity (ps_availqty) must be greater than half of the total quantity shipped by that supplier for that part in 1994
4. Ship date must be between 1994-01-01 and 1995-01-01 (inclusive of start, exclusive of end)
5. Output: s_name, s_address
6. Sort by supplier name

SELECT n.n_name, SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS revenue
    FROM region r
    JOIN nation n ON r.r_regionkey = n.n_regionkey
    JOIN customer c ON n.n_nationkey = c.c_nationkey
    JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey
    JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    JOIN supplier s ON l.l_suppkey = s.s_suppkey
    WHERE r.r_name = 'ASIA'
    AND c.c_nationkey = s.s_nationkey
    AND o.o_orderdate >= '1994-01-01'
    AND o.o_orderdate < '1995-01-01'
    GROUP BY n.n_name
    ORDER BY revenue DESC

    WITH filtered_data AS (
        SELECT
            o.o_orderkey,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.o_orderdate) AS o_year,
            SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue,
            SUM(CASE WHEN n.n_nationkey = (SELECT n_nationkey FROM nation WHERE n_name = 'BRAZIL') THEN l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount) ELSE 0 END) AS brazil_revenue
        FROM orders o
        JOIN customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
        JOIN nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
        JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
        JOIN lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey

    ```sql
        JOIN nation n_br_as_supplier ON s.s_nationkey = n_br_as_supplier.n_nationkey
        WHERE r.r_name = 'AMERICA'
          AND p.p_type = 'ECONOMY ANODIZED STEEL'
          AND o.o_orderdate >= '1995-01-01'
          AND o.o_orderdate <= '1996-12-31'
        GROUP BY o.o_orderkey, o_year
    )
    SELECT o_year, brazil_revenue / total_revenue AS mkt_share
    FROM filtered_data
    ORDER BY o_year;
    ```
